comparison.objective: Seat a strut across a keep-out region.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and place an elongated structural member into its seats while keeping the member and hands clear of a forbidden zone.
comparison.success_condition: Strut is correctly supported at its endpoints without keep-out intrusion, collision, or loss.
comparison.reason: Endpoint seating across a keep-out tests constrained placement, not continuous coaxial support and sliding transfer of an uncaged recirculating assembly. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
